Class JsonBoardConfigLoader

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.config.JsonBoardConfigLoader
All Implemented Interfaces:
BoardConfigLoader
public class JsonBoardConfigLoader extends Object implements BoardConfigLoader
BoardConfigLoader implementation that reads game configuration from JSON resource files bundled in the classpath (/cards/, /offer_tiles.json, /order_tiles.json, /game_settings.json).

Card and building objects are instantiated via the static parser maps (CARD_PARSERS, BUILDING_PARSERS), keyed on the "type" field in each JSON node.

    • getCards

      public ArrayList<Set<Card>> getCards(int numPlayers)
      Returns cards grouped by era (index 0 = era1, 1 = era2, 2 = era3). Loads cards_2p.json as base, then incrementally adds cards from 3p, 4p, 5p files. Suitable to pass directly to Deck.createDeck().
      Specified by:
      getCards in interface BoardConfigLoader
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players (2–5)
      Returns:
      list of card sets, one per era plus one for final events
